Summary of work so far (round 1 of 12 released; rounds 02-12 still to release):

Round 1 contents (/task/fixtures/round-01/):
- Files: board.md, changes.md, logs/{pricing-svc,auth-svc,payments-svc,ledger-svc,inventory-svc}.log
- Line counts: pricing 56, auth 65, payments 56, ledger 71, inventory 62.
- board.md is empty: no incident threads opened yet and no follow-up items opened or closed.
- changes.md: CHG-112 APPLIED: log sampling for /v1/health reduced to 1%. This looks benign/noise but could explain missing health logs later.
- Log format: "2026-09-14T08:MM:SSZ LEVEL  <service> <message> key=val ...", for example "WARN  pricing-svc slow query ms=253 table=items". The format may change in later rounds.

Round 1 observations:
- All 5 services emit background WARN "slow query" lines (ms roughly 200-450, tables items/orders/events). These look like baseline noise, not an incident.
- auth-svc has repeated "WARN heap usage high rss_mb=... gc_pause_ms=...".
  - Lines: 3, 14, 32, 35, 40, 46, 60, 61.
  - rss_mb fluctuates 1967-3800 and gc_pause up to 1389ms (line 46).
  - No clear monotonic growth or restarts yet. This is a possible early MEMORY_LEAK signal; watch for growth and restarts.
  - Evidence ref: round-01/logs/auth-svc.log:3-61.
- No ERROR lines in any service in round 1.

Incidents: none confirmed yet.

Next steps:
- Advance to round 2.
- Each round: read board.md (latest update per thread wins; unmentioned fields are unchanged) and changes.md (only APPLIED changes count; note PROPOSED ones).
- Grep logs for ERROR/WARN, plus new patterns (429, cert, DNS, pool, lag, disk, OOM/restart, config) and any format changes.
- Track incident threads (cause, superseded cause, services, status plus the record that set it), follow-up codes opened/closed, and file:line evidence.
- Final answer only after all 12 rounds are released.
